title: NalamMesh: Offline Triage and Tracked Referrals for Rural Public Health in Maharashtra
description:
NalamMesh is an offline-first app for Sub-Centre, PHC, CHC, SDH and District Hospital staff in Maharashtra, built for Smart India Hackathon 2026, Problem Statement 26133 (Government of Maharashtra), by Team TechDevs_6 (Team ID 178601), R M K College of Engineering and Technology.

It triages patients on the phone using IPHS 2022 danger-sign rules with a small on-device ML model, refers them to the nearest facility with a free bed, the right equipment and a specialist, tracks every referral from sent to discharged, and escalates an emergency that is not acknowledged within 10 minutes to the District Health Officer.
